titles.title: Geometry of Persisting (Beyond Life) — A Poster Collection

descriptions.description: Volume III of the Geometry Trilogy, presented as a twenty-three-chapter poster collection built on the kitab template. Where Volume I (Geometry of Becoming) asks under what conditions an intent-bearing semantic structure can emerge, and Volume II (Geometry of Living) asks how such structures are maintained under continuous perturbation, Volume III asks the invariance question: what remains mathematically invariant when all physical realization is allowed to change. Chapters span the axiomatic foundation of intent dynamics; realization theory and substrate independence; the civilizational architecture of matter, energy and intent; institutions, economy, and information rights; memory, longevity, and the identity ontology of persistent semantic continuity; and the sacred and cosmic frontiers. Presented as an integrative research proposal, not established consensus. One poster per chapter, each a self-describing figure with explanation, read-aloud, and Ask-AI tools.
